response.overview: The feature-length documentary *El punto* (The Point) revitalizes the revolutionary thought of Ismael Quiles, a Spanish Jesuit priest and philosopher based in Buenos Aires. The film traces the journey of one of the most brilliant and avant-garde minds of 20th-century Argentina, while also exploring his role as a pioneer in the dialogue between East and West. Through previously unseen archival footage and testimonies from experts and witnesses to Quiles’s life and work, the film becomes a necessary journey of introspection regarding identity, inviting the viewer to discover their own inner core—"the point," a central concept in Quiles’s philosophy.
response.title: El Punto
